output.one_liner: Gorgias is a conversational AI platform for ecommerce support and helpdesk management.

auth.notes: API key for private apps only (HTTP Basic auth with base64-encoded username:api_key). OAuth2 mandatory for public apps.

evidence.snippet: the API key authentication method can be used only for private apps. If you plan to build a public app you have to use OAuth2.
Using OAuth2 is mandatory for public apps.

access.notes: API keys are self-serve from account settings. Free trial accounts available; conversion to developer sandbox requires contacting support.

evidence.snippet: As an admin, you can easily generate and revoke your access token in the settings of your account.
Once you register, feel free to create a trial account and reach out to [email protected] to transform it into a developer account.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: OAuth2 apps: 80 requests per 20 seconds; API key integrations: 40 requests per 20 seconds; Enterprise: 10-second window

evidence.snippet: The Gorgias API is structured with REST in mind. Our API has predictable resource-oriented URLs, accepts JSON-encoded responses
OAuth2 apps can make 80 requests in a 20 second window
The Gorgias MCP lets you work with your Gorgias helpdesk using an AI assistant, like Claude or ChatGPT.
the connection URL is the same: https://mcp.gorgias.com/mcp
An MCP server for interacting with the Gorgias helpdesk API. This server provides tools and resources

buildability.rationale: Fully documented REST API with broad resource coverage; self-serve API key access; Composio toolkit already in production with 51 tools.

overview_evidence.snippet: Bring your support team, customer data, workflows, and AI Agent together in one platform built for every stage of the customer journey.
With managed OAuth you don't need your own Gorgias app or client credentials. The flow starts in Gorgias and finishes in Composio.
